messages:
sara: Heads-up — canary run for runtime v3.1 -> sdk-shim 2.7 shows degraded longseq correctness. I think we should hold the runtime unpin for the longseq model group until a shim patch is out.

mike: Got logs?

sara: Pasting short repro from canary (truncated):
```
model: longseq-gptq
request: "generate 5k tokens with KV reuse"
runtime: 3.1
sdk-shim: 2.7
behavior: drift + repeated token loops at ~2.5k tokens
```

mike: Yikes. That looks like the KV index offset bug we saw in internal tests. Possibly a kernel selection mismatch on the new attention path.

jasmine: If we hold unpin, what's the customer impact? Any production traffic affected?

sara: Only canary and internal stress tests hit longseq at scale; we haven't yet routed customer traffic. But the runtime unpin was scheduled to lift tomorrow (change window 09:00 UTC). If we lift, some customers could see degraded outputs — not latency, correctness.

kevin: QA confirms a reproducible divergence in 2/3 scenarios. We have a narrow fix in the SDK shim (2.7.1) that reindexes KV correctly; need one more perf regression check.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime unpin for v3.1 -> change window 1719900000 (2024-06-xx 09:00 UTC). Current pinlist: runtime:3.1 pinned for model group longseq.

sara: Proposal: keep longseq pinned on runtime:3.0 (current stable) for 24-48h, release SDK shim 2.7.1 to canary, re-run the longseq canary, then lift pin if green. Also add a fallback routing rule to route longseq to dedicated pool if runtime 3.1 shows regressions in prod.

mike: Agree. Action items: 1) @jasmine update pinlist in deploybot to add an exemption for longseq until 1719986400 (+48h). 2) @kevin run perf/regression job on shim 2.7.1 (matrix: seq_len=5k, batch=1, quant=4bit). 3) @sara coordinate canary re-run and collect logs.

jasmine: I can update deploy-bot. Command I'll run: ```/deploybot pin add runtime:3.0 --group longseq --until 1719986400 --reason "sdk-shim mismatch"```

kevin: QA schedule: starting now, hope to have results in ~2 hours.

qa-bot: qa-bot: regression job queued: job_id=QA-4827, expected finish 1719809260.

mike: Also we should prepare rollback instructions if we inadvertently route some prod traffic. Draft rollback:
- Re-enable pinlist for longseq (if it somehow toggles off).
- Route longseq model group to regional fallback pool (eu-west-1) via routing rule: `route.add longseq -> pool:d-excluded-runtime-3.1`
- Temporary throttle longseq traffic to 20 rps.

ops-runbooks: Noted. I'll add an entry under "runtime unpin contingency" with those exact steps and a contact list (oncall + eng-runtime).

sara: Thanks. If QA passes, we'll plan a soft-unpin attempt in the next change window and keep canary at 5% traffic with a watch for token-divergence regressions. If QA fails, we'll keep the longseq pin until we merge the shim fix into main and run a second canary.

mike: One more ask: capture the exact diff in logits for a canonical prompt (we use prompt id longseq-canon-01). That will make rollbacks and postmortems clearer.

sara: Adding to checklist. Quick checklist I'm adding here: 
- [ ] jasmine: add pin exemption for longseq until 1719986400
- [ ] kevin: finish QA job QA-4827 and post results
- [ ] sara: run canary with shim 2.7.1 and attach logs (longseq-canon-01)
- [ ] mike: prepare rollback snippet and perf notes
- [ ] ops-runbooks: add contingency runbook entry

jasmine: Pin added. deploy-bot returned: `pinlist:update: success (entry id 9201) - runtime:3.0 -> group:longseq until 1719986400` :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Note: automatic unpin checks paused for group longseq until 1719986400 per pinlist entry 9201.

kevin: QA finished: divergence fixed on shim 2.7.1, perf within 3% of baseline. Uploading logs to 
https://redwood-internal/qa/QA-4827/results

mike: Great. sara can you kick the canary with 5% traffic and monitor token-diff metric (alerts if >0.5% of requests show divergence beyond threshold)?

sara: Starting canary now. Will post results within 30m.

(30m later)

sara: Canary green: token-diff under threshold, no loop regressions seen. Rolling plan: remove pin for longseq in next change window 1719900000 but with strict canary gating (5% -> 25% -> 100%, 30m between increments).

mike: Approved. After unpin, leave an automated regression check for 24h and auto-repin if divergence rate >0.5%.

jasmine: Scheduling unpin and gating in deploy-bot now. Command: ```/deploybot unpin runtime:3.0 --group longseq --change-window 1719900000 --gates "canary:5,25,100" --auto-repin "divergence>0.5% 24h"```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Unpin scheduled and gating configured. Change window 1719900000. Auto-repin rule added.

ops-runbooks: Runbook updated with job ids, pinlist entry id 9201, and rollback steps.

sara: Thanks all. Closing thread when unpin completes successfully, else reopen with rollback notes. :thumbsup:
